findings.claim: Planetary Science is a first-class comparative planetary-systems domain bridging astronomy and Earth/geoscience, but not yet an independent canonical major region.
Biochemistry, Microbiology, Developmental Biology and Physiology are stable life-science identities with different bridge/process/function roles; none requires wholesale root promotion.

Engineering specialties are best represented as explicit major subspaces/intervention bridges under the broader Engineering/Design topology, not as peer foundational regions by institutional symmetry.
Philosophy of Mind is a major philosophical subspace and cognition bridge; Philology is a historical-language/textual bridge and method axis.
Food Science is a stable applied/composite domain spanning chemistry, biology, microbiology, engineering and human/nutrition boundaries rather than a foundational major region.
All 17 residual candidates from the v0 broad census are now explicitly normalized; this closes only that bounded residual set, not the open-world foundational census.
